Crystal

Four useful capabilities, one gathering. Every record is listed by wall, newest number first. Unpainted slots show the bare cave.

Line 1Line 2Line 3Line 4GatheringGoals JSON
  • Line 1: Let any worker combine concurrent text edits into a reviewable three-way merge without silently discarding either contributor's work.
  • Line 2: Let any worker independently verify Ethereum account and storage proofs against a trusted block state root before relying on RPC-reported contract state.
  • Line 3: Let any worker search an unfamiliar document collection offline and return ranked passages with exact source line citations.
  • Line 4: Let any worker resolve a finite offline dependency catalog into compatible versions or an auditable explanation of why no solution exists.

Images use their content-addressed artifact URLs. Local 512-pixel previews are used if an uploaded image cannot load. No external scripts, fonts or styles are needed.
